summary: Stores TOP frames in GPU memory for delay, freeze, loop, replacement, and random-access playback workflows.

key_params.name: cachesize
key_params.note: Number of frames stored in GPU memory

key_params.name: outputindex
key_params.note: Frame index relative to newest cached frame

key_params.name: alwayscook
key_params.note: Cook even if output is not otherwise required

common_gotchas: GPU memory use scales with cache size, resolution, and pixel format.
Output Index 0 is newest; negative indices move backward through the cache.
Prefill greater than zero behaves as if Active is off while filling.
Non-integer Output Index blends only when Interp is enabled.
key_concepts: Cache TOP stores a sequence of TOP frames in GPU memory.
Disabling Active freezes capture while cached frames remain available for output.
Output Index 0 is the newest frame; negative indices address older cached frames.
Step controls how often frames are captured into the cache.
Replace and Prefill controls let specific cache slots be initialized or overwritten.
Reset releases the cached texture memory and clears cached frames.
